encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: μάλα ταχέως αὐτῶν πρίω μοι πουλύπουν,
καὶ δὸς καταφαγεῖν κἀπὸ τηγάνου γόνον.

div.note: Athenaeus 3, 108 c Ἡγήμων δ’ ἐν Φιλίννῃ καὶ γόνον ἐκ ταγήνου ἐσθίοντας ποιεῖ ἐν τούτοις κτλ.

πρίω μοι Meinek.] πριώ A. πρίω τὸν Schweighaeus., πρίω σὺ Coraes Xenocr. 206, ταχέως ἰὼν πρίω μοι Cobet. N. 1. 141 et in Athenaeo Meinekius. πουλύπουν] πώλυπον A. pro μάλα Iacobs. Addit. Athen. 71 ἀλλὰ, Dobraeus μἀλλὰ, et pro αὐτῶν Iacobs. αὐτῷ (πρίω σὺ). αὐτῶν in ed. mai. Meinekius nummos esse putabat ‘quorum in antecedentibus mentio facta’ esset. γόνος sunt pisces minuti. Archestr. Athen. 7, 285 b τὸν γόνον ἐξαυδῶ, τὸν ἀφρὸν καλέουσιν Ἴωνες.
